params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: threeStates
params.description: True = three-states checkbox, False = standard checkbox

overloads.semanticRole: Enables or disables, for the current process, the 'Three-States' (semi-checked) mode of the checkbox(es) designated by object and *.

constraints: Only applies to checkboxes bound to variables; has no effect on Boolean fields displayed as checkboxes.
